response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS overall_net FROM fees), per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - o.overall_net) AS mean_excess_over_overall FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_net > o.overall_net
